userProfile.bio: Emmanuel Miro is an Italian Techno DJ and producer whose trajectory is currently one of the most compelling in the international scene. Known for a surgical production precision and a sonic signature that bridges deep, dark atmospheres with relentless energy, Miro has rapidly ascended to the forefront of the genre. The beginning of 2026 marks a career-defining period for Miro, headlined by the high-voltage release "Neural Acid" on IAMT Music (February 13th). This follows the powerful "Dual Resolution EP" on Sisko Electrofanatik’s Gain Records (February 6th) and his standout track "Estoria" on the heavyweight Autektone (late December 2025). Influenced by the foundations of the 90s—from Jeff Mills to Richie Hawtin—Miro has evolved into a master of modern peak-time and raw techno. His catalog boasts signatures on some of the circuit's most respected imprints, including: IAMT Music Autektone Gain Records Eclipse Recordings Dreizehn Schallplatten Whether in the studio or commanding the booth with his signature dark, psychedelic soundscapes, Emmanuel Miro remains dedicated to the mantra: "Don't make war, do techno." With a global listener base stretching from Berlin to Santiago, he continues to engineer tracks designed to dominate sound systems and trigger total system overload
